evidence_policy: A current rule may broaden normative branch coverage without adding a new counted identity.

decisions.current_explanation: Current academic rules explicitly preserve точь-в-точь as a traditional two-hyphen spelling; it should not be generalized from ordinary prepositional repeated combinations.
decisions.patch_policy: Strengthen the learner rationale as a traditional spelling boundary; do not invent a productive two-hyphen template.
Keep the identity but avoid wording that makes it look like a suffix-only exception; treat ЕЩЁ as a current lexical spelling case within the broader О/Ё/Е-after-sibilants system.

decisions.part_of_speech_boundary_note: Other no-soft-sign words after a final sibilant such as аж and меж belong to other parts of speech and are not absorbed into this adverb identity.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the adverb triad exact; completeness is not achieved by mixing unrelated parts of speech into one exception set.

decisions.contrast_model: Hyphenated adverb must be distinguished from preposition ПО + declined adjective/pronoun + noun, e.g. по моему мнению, по прежнему плану.
special_current_notes: по-латыни is also hyphenated by special rule
по-его, по-её, по-их are hyphenated adverbs in the current academic rule
decisions.patch_policy: Expand normative branch metadata under the existing decision engine; do not create separate identities for each suffix pattern or example.

decisions.current_rule: Pronoun words with initial кое-/кой- and final -то/-либо/-нибудь are hyphenated; when a preposition intervenes after кое-, forms are written separately.
decisions.current_scope_note: The same orthographic decision extends to the corresponding pronominal adverbs (кое-когда, кое-куда, где-либо, как-нибудь, etc.) without creating a new identity.
decisions.patch_policy: Broaden normative examples only; preserve source-grade scopes exactly.

decisions.current_scope_note: Current academic rules also cover the corresponding pronominal adverbs (некогда, негде, никогда, нигде, etc.) within the same НЕ-/НИ- orthographic system.
decisions.patch_policy: No identity split. Keep stress choice and preposition separation in one structured learner decision.
